def factor_reversal_sublinear_volume(df):
    """Short-term reversal with sublinear volume scaling to dampen extreme volume spikes."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    ret_5d = df_copy["close"].pct_change(5)
    volume_scaler = np.sqrt(np.maximum(vol_ratio - 1.0, 0.0))
    factor = -ret_5d * volume_scaler
    df_copy["factor_reversal_sublinear_volume"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_reversal_sublinear_volume"]
description: Preserves the parent's core price-volume reversal mechanism: extreme price moves accompanied by abnormal volume tend to revert. The mutation replaces the linear volume scaling (vol_ratio - 1) with a square-root scaling, which dampens the impact of very high volume spikes. This reduces tail sensitivity and aims to improve the signal's stability (ICIR) while maintaining the mean-reversion edge. The square-root transform ensures that volume amplification is sub-linear, giving a smoother, more robust signal without sacrificing the core economic intuition. Parent strength target: ICIR and RankICIR stability.
